quests.instruction: A box is described with two clues: it is yellow and it is long and curved. Which object fits?
quests.explanation: A banana is yellow and long and curved. A lemon is yellow, but not long.
quests.funFact: Bananas grow in bunches that point upward.

quests.instruction: Which two objects share the same color?
quests.hint: Find the two that are red.
quests.explanation: A fire truck and a ripe tomato are both red.
quests.funFact: Many red things get noticed quickly.

quests.instruction: Which item belongs in the blue group?
quests.explanation: A blueberry is blue, while pumpkin is orange and corn is yellow.
quests.funFact: Blue foods are rare in nature.

quests.instruction: Look at these: snowman, milk, chalk, coal. Which one is the odd one out?
quests.explanation: Coal is black, and the others are white.
quests.funFact: Coal is a black rock that can burn.

quests.instruction: A secret object is orange and is a vegetable. Which could it be?
quests.hint: It must be orange and a vegetable.
quests.explanation: A carrot is an orange vegetable.
quests.funFact: Carrots grow underground.

quests.instruction: A clue says: "It is long, green and crunchy, and it grows on a vine." Which food is it?
quests.explanation: A cucumber is long and green, and it grows on a vine.
quests.funFact: A pickle starts out as a cucumber.

quests.instruction: You see a red balloon, a red apple and a red bus in a picture. A fourth thing is added. Which one fits the group?
quests.hint: Look at what the first three have in common.
quests.explanation: A strawberry is red, so it fits the group.
quests.funFact: Groups form when things share a feature.

quests.instruction: Which one does NOT belong in the "cool colors" group?
quests.hint: Cool colors look like water and leaves.
quests.explanation: Orange is warm, while blue and green are cool.
quests.funFact: Cool colors can seem calm.

quests.instruction: Two crayons are mixed to make purple. One is red. What is the other?
quests.explanation: Red and blue is the pair that mixes into purple.
quests.funFact: The other primary color is yellow.

quests.instruction: Clue: it is a small, round, red fruit with a stem and a pit inside. What is it?
quests.explanation: A cherry is red, round and has a pit.
quests.funFact: Cherries are related to plums and peaches.

quests.instruction: Which animal could be both gray and large?
quests.explanation: An elephant is gray and large.
quests.funFact: An elephant's skin has many wrinkles.

quests.instruction: Which is different: lime, pea, plum?
quests.explanation: A lime and a pea are green, and a plum is purple.
quests.funFact: Plums can also be red or yellow.

quests.instruction: A girl says, "My shoes are the color of a stop sign, and my socks are the color of the sky." Which colors are they?
quests.hint: Match each clue to its color.
quests.explanation: The shoes are red and the socks are blue.
quests.funFact: Colors can be combined to make an outfit.

quests.instruction: Which two things belong in the same color group?
quests.explanation: A dandelion and a rubber duck are both yellow.
quests.funFact: Dandelion flowers turn into fluffy white seeds.

quests.instruction: Which of these has more than one color?
quests.explanation: A zebra has black and white stripes.
quests.funFact: A lemon is just one color.

quests.instruction: A fruit has dark purple skin and a pale inside. Which fruit could it be?
quests.explanation: A plum has purple skin and pale flesh, while a kiwi is green inside and a banana is yellow outside.
quests.funFact: Plum trees blossom in spring before the fruit appears.

quests.instruction: Which two items are both black?
quests.explanation: A tire and a crow are both black.
quests.funFact: Black objects soak up a lot of light.

quests.instruction: If something is NOT red and NOT yellow, which of these could it be?
quests.hint: Rule out two of the options.
quests.explanation: A frog is neither red nor yellow, so it fits.
quests.funFact: Using clues helps you rule out choices.

quests.instruction: You are packing a picnic. The napkin is the color of a daffodil. The cup is the color of the sky. Which cup color matches the sky?
quests.hint: Look at the clues for the cup.
quests.explanation: The cup matches the sky, so it is blue.
quests.funFact: A daffodil is yellow.

quests.instruction: Which description fits a ripe pumpkin?
quests.explanation: A pumpkin is orange and round.
quests.funFact: A pumpkin can be carved or baked into pies.

quests.instruction: Which group is all green?
quests.explanation: Cucumber, lime and broccoli are all green.
quests.funFact: Green fruits and vegetables are common.

quests.instruction: Only two crayons are left in the box: black and white. Which picture could you color best with only these?
quests.hint: It may remind you of an animal with two colors.
quests.explanation: A panda is black and white.
quests.funFact: You can make many pictures with just two colors.

quests.instruction: Three cups stand in a line: red, blue and green. The blue cup is between the other two. Which cup is NOT at an end?
quests.hint: The middle cup has a cup on each side.
quests.explanation: The blue cup is in the middle, with red and green at the ends.
quests.funFact: Clues about position and color work together.

quests.instruction: Which of these is both white and sweet?
quests.explanation: Sugar is white and sweet.
quests.funFact: Sugar can come from sugarcane.

quests.instruction: Which pair does NOT match?
quests.hint: Two go together, and one does not.
quests.explanation: A banana is not blue, so that pair does not match.
quests.funFact: Not all fruits are yellow.

quests.instruction: Your friend says: "It is small, it is red and it has black spots." What is it?
quests.explanation: A ladybug is small and red with black spots.
quests.funFact: Ladybugs can have different numbers of spots.

quests.instruction: Which of these is NOT in the rainbow?
quests.explanation: Black is not in the rainbow.
quests.funFact: The rainbow has red on the outside and violet on the inside.

quests.instruction: You sort crayons into a light cup and a dark cup. Which crayon goes in the dark cup?
quests.explanation: Navy is dark, while pale yellow and cream are light.
quests.funFact: Light and dark are another way to sort colors.

quests.instruction: Which one has two colors, brown and white?
quests.explanation: Many cows are brown and white.
quests.funFact: Cows come in many colors.

quests.instruction: A color is made from red and yellow, and a pumpkin is that color. Which color is it?
quests.explanation: Red and yellow make orange, which is a pumpkin's color.
quests.funFact: Orange is made by mixing.
